title: The River That Changed Its Mind
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：head　|　正文 385 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 head 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The river behind our village has changed its course four times in nine hundred years and its ① head twice, which is why two parishes have been arguing about the same water since 1604. Where a river ② heads is a fact; who owns the fact is a lawsuit. The head, in our family, was whoever could read the map. My grandfather, who ③ headed the water committee for nineteen years and was head of half a dozen other things besides, said the argument was never really about water.

He took me to the source when I was ten. The ④ head of the valley was a wet field with a spring in it, no wider than a table, and the river began there in eleven places at once. Springs, he said, are ⑤ headstrong: they go where the rock lets them and nowhere else, and no amount of paperwork has ever changed one. He was a quiet man and this was the nearest he came to a joke.

Below the village the water is ⑥ headed for the mill race, which was cut in 1711 and has been silting up ever since. Half of it now goes where it went before 1711, and the miller, whose family has complained for three hundred years, complains still. I asked my grandfather who was right. 'Nobody,' he said. 'A river has no ⑦ head for argument, and neither does a miller.'

In 1997 the committee voted to ⑧ head off the flood with a wall, and the wall was built, and the water came over the top of it in 2000 and again in 2007. What saved the village both times was not the wall but the field above it, which is ⑨ head-high with grass in June and holds the water like a sponge. Nobody had counted the field.

The head of the parish council wrote to the paper in 1998 and got two letters back. My grandfather died in 2003 and the committee's ⑩ head was a man from the council who had never walked to the spring. The wall is still there. The field is still there. The river, which has no interest in either of them, is currently two hundred metres east of where the 1604 map says it should be, and I have decided that this is not a failure of management.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 头；头部（此处指河源、水源）
B. n. 首领；负责人；带头人
C. v. 朝……行进；走向（head for/towards）
D. v. 领导；主管；负责（head a committee）
E. adj. 任性的；倔强的（headstrong）
F. adj. 齐头高的；到头部高度的（head-high）
G. 固定搭配：head off 阻止；拦住；抢先制止
H. n. 头脑；才智；理解力（a head for）

items.q: Where a river heads is a fact
the water is headed for the mill race
A river has no head for argument
the committee voted to head off the flood
which is head-high with grass in June
the committee's head was a man from the council

answers.why: 指河的“源头”，说九百年间河源改过两次，故两个教区争了四百年。
head 作动词，意为“朝……走、流向”，说河往哪流是事实，谁拥有这个事实才是官司。
动词，意为“领导、负责”，说祖父主持水务委员会十九年。
the head of the valley 意为“山谷的顶端、源头处”，指那片有泉的湿地。
headstrong 意为“倔强的、任性的”，用拟人说法形容泉水只走岩石允许的路。
be headed for 意为“朝……去、流向”，说水流向 1711 年开凿的磨坊引水渠。
a head for 意为“有……的头脑、才智”，no head for argument 即“不善争辩”。
head off 意为“拦住、抢先制止”，说委员会投票决定修墙挡住洪水。
head-high 意为“齐头高的”，说六月草长得与人齐高。
head 作名词指“负责人、首领”，说委员会后来由一位从没去过泉眼的议员当头。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 九百年间这条河的源头改过两次。（head）
河往哪儿流是事实。（head v.）
我祖父主持水务委员会十九年。（head v.）
泉水是倔强的：只走岩石允许的路。（headstrong）
委员会投票决定修墙拦住洪水。（head off）
六月里那片地上的草长得齐人头高。（head-high）
answers: The river has changed its head twice in nine hundred years.
Where a river heads is a fact.
My grandfather headed the water committee for nineteen years.
Springs are headstrong: they go where the rock lets them and nowhere else.
The committee voted to head off the flood with a wall.
In June the field is head-high with grass.
